decision: Held decision on the W5c residual (owner, 2026-09-22: proceed with the lead's recommendations): tighten the Dake 9.2 oil in place tolerance.

tighten.why: At tol 3 MMSTB the field passed Dake's own published least squares fit (310.2 MMSTB, 2.98 off) and the course's one-parameter history match (310.1986 MMSTB, 2.98 off), so a learner who copied the textbook number passed without running the engine. The engine is deterministic on the capstone case: the tank explorer's Dake mode with the finite Carter-Tracy aquifer prints 307.22141 MMSTB, 0.00000045 off the key, and every solver choice returns the same value. Tol 0.5 is half a unit of the coarsest honest report, a whole MMSTB: 307 passes (0.22 off), 310.2 fails by 2.48, Dake's truth 312 fails, and the whole 95 percent interval of the history match (308.55 to 311.86 MMSTB) lies outside the band. hdDakeTol.test.js derives all of it from the vendored engine.
